_comment: Source-of-truth manifest for which env vars must differ between Vercel Production and Preview scopes. Source for the operator runbook in docs/live-infra-setup.md §8.3 and the future automated audit script. See issue #18 for the policy decisions backing each bucket. NOT directly consumed by the app or Vercel — this file is documentation + tooling input.

_notes.scopeSpecific: Production scope uses production values; Preview scope uses staging values. Same value in both scopes is the failure mode this manifest exists to prevent. Examples: AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET shared = cross-scope cookie validity; RESEND_API_KEY shared = staging emails sent from production-keyed account; SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY shared = staging writes hit production DB.
_notes.previewUnsetPreferred: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL on Preview scope causes magic-link emails from preview deploys to point at the production host instead of the preview alias. Cookie-domain mismatch when the user clicks. Unset on Preview means lib/env.ts falls back to https://$VERCEL_URL, which is the actual preview alias. Fix: delete the env var from Preview scope.
_notes.sharedAllowed: Same value across both scopes is intentional. DRAFT_PREVIEW=1 on both is correct (lib/preview.ts:29 short-circuits on production via VERCEL_ENV check). STAGING_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS doesn't matter on Production scope but having it set is harmless. STAGING_DATA_RETENTION_DAYS could be Preview-only, but having it on Production scope is also harmless because the cron-purge code path keys off environment column in retention_log, not the env var alone.
_notes.audit_script_intent: When the audit lands (deferred per #18 Decision #5), it computes sha256 of each scopeSpecific value in both scopes. Fail if hashes match. For previewUnsetPreferred: fail if Preview scope has the var set. For sharedAllowed: no assertion. Output is hash comparisons + pass/fail summary; never logs raw secret values.
